meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先写出一份设计哲学（.md 文件），再据此生成一张原创视觉作品（.png/.pdf 海报或艺术图）。画面以空间、颜色和少量文字为主，不复制已有艺术家作品，细节要显得被精心打磨过。
howto.when: 当用户要求创作海报、艺术作品、设计等静态视觉作品时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张独立乐队巡演海报。
say.note: Claude 会先写出设计哲学，再输出海报文件。

say.text: 我想创作一幅以“潮汐”为主题的抽象艺术图。
say.note: 它会先提炼主题，再用构图与色彩表达出来。

say.text: 做一个极简风格的展览邀请函，单页 PDF 即可。
say.note: 它会在 .md 中记录思路，并输出整页 PDF。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first writes a design philosophy (.md) for the request, then creates an original visual piece (.png/.pdf poster or artwork). The work prioritizes space, color, and minimal text, never copies existing artists' work, and should look painstakingly crafted.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create a poster, a piece of art, a design, or another static visual piece.

say_en.text: Design a poster for an indie band tour.
say_en.note: Claude writes the philosophy .md first, then the poster.

say_en.text: Create an abstract artwork themed around 'tides'.
say_en.note: It distills the theme into composition and color.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist single-page PDF invitation for an exhibition.
say_en.note: It records the concept in a .md and delivers the PDF.
